clippings.speaker: Brad Bird
clippings.quote: I had a great secret weapon: Michael Giacchino was doing the music. He wrote a suite just for the orchestra to do one take, so he could hear it.
clippings.title: Brad Bird looks back at greatest movies: Iron Giant, Incredibles, Ratatouille
clippings.context: Bird recounting the Ratatouille pitch for the film's ending during a San Diego Comic-Con retrospective of his career.

clippings.speaker: Brad Bird
clippings.quote: Michael Giacchino loves movies. He's really concerned with the storytelling aspect.
clippings.title: Brad Bird interview: Mission: Impossible, The Iron Giant, Die Hard, fast edits and movie music
clippings.context: Bird in an interview with Den of Geek on what his working relationship with Giacchino is built on; the page has no speaker labels, so attribution is by context.

clippings.speaker: Brad Bird
clippings.quote: It's kind of like me going down the street and going, 'Can Michael come out and play?' … There's a very childlike vibe. We get very enthusiastic about things.
clippings.title: Brad Bird and Michael Giacchino on the Long Road to 'Ray Gunn'
clippings.context: Bird describing their creative partnership in an interview about the long road to Ray Gunn.

clippings.speaker: Michael Giacchino
clippings.quote: There's always a push and a shove, and him trying to drag me this way, me trying to drag him this way, and somewhere meeting in the middle, we make the thing
clippings.title: Brad Bird and Michael Giacchino on the Long Road to 'Ray Gunn'
clippings.context: Giacchino, asked whether their long history gives them creative shorthand, in an interview about Ray Gunn.

clippings.speaker: Michael Giacchino
clippings.quote: We started talking instantly about all the animation we loved growing up… Jonny Quest became the thing where they had to separate us.
clippings.title: Brad Bird and Michael Giacchino on the Long Road to 'Ray Gunn'
clippings.context: Giacchino recalling how he and Bird first met at Pixar, bonding over Hanna-Barbera's Jonny Quest.

clippings.speaker: Michael Giacchino
clippings.quote: Yes, Brad wanted me to express the taste of food with music, while he would do the same with the images.
clippings.title: Michael Giacchino interview: Ratatouille, Mission: Impossible
clippings.context: Giacchino in an interview ahead of the Royal Albert Hall screening of Ratatouille, on how the score and images split the work.

notes: Bird-side quotes are scarce: Variety (2015) and Billboard pages were blocked, and the Gold Derby and Nerds of Color pieces carried the rest. The 2011 Den of Geek quote has no speaker labels, so attribution is by context.
